description: Wallet Tasks 3-4: Implement wallet account/invitation/isolation with lifecycle state machine, and human step-up with principal consent attestation (CTP counter.principal-consent-attestation.v1)
steps: Task 3 - Wallet lifecycle state machine in packages/wallet-domain/src/: Implement validated state transitions (INVITED->ENROLLED->VERIFIED->ACTIVE, ACTIVE->SUSPENDED, ACTIVE->RECOVERY_LOCKED, ACTIVE->OFFBOARDING->CLOSED, SUSPENDED->ACTIVE, RECOVERY_LOCKED->ACTIVE). Each transition records actor, reason, prior/new state, timestamp, and evidence reference. Invalid transitions fail with descriptive errors.

Task 3 - Wallet/Principal/Invite schemas in packages/wallet-domain/src/: Define WalletAccount (id, principalId, state, environment, createdAt, metadata), WalletPrincipal (id, walletId, authMethod, enrolledAt, verifiedAt), WalletInvitation (id, walletId, email/identifier, status: pending/accepted/expired/revoked, expiresAt, allowlistEntry). All use CounterId branded types from @counter/domain.

Task 3 - Repository ports in packages/wallet-domain/src/repositories.ts: Define WalletRepository, PrincipalRepository, InvitationRepository interfaces with CRUD + query operations. Include isolation guarantees (all queries scoped by walletId).

Task 3 - In-memory repository implementations for testing in packages/wallet-domain/src/: Implement InMemoryWalletRepository, InMemoryPrincipalRepository, InMemoryInvitationRepository with proper isolation (Wallet A cannot see Wallet B data).

Task 3 - Isolation tests: Add comprehensive tests in packages/wallet-domain/src/index.test.ts covering: state transition validation (valid transitions succeed, invalid fail), cross-wallet isolation (Wallet A data invisible to Wallet B queries), suspended/locked/closed wallets reject mutations, invite allowlist enforcement.

Task 4 - Step-up service in packages/wallet-application/src/step-up-service.ts: Define StepUpRequirement (operation types requiring step-up: policy_widening, agent_key_change, payment_reference_change, mandate_consent, approval, recovery, export, closure). Implement staleness check (step-up expires after configurable TTL). Define StepUpSession (principalId, method, assurance, authenticatedAt, expiresAt, nonce).

Task 4 - Principal consent attestation builder in packages/wallet-application/src/consent-attestation.ts: Build CTP 'counter.principal-consent-attestation.v1' envelope with: exact SHA-256 digest of consented content, auth method (pilot_password, webauthn, external_provider), assurance level (basic, substantial, high), auth timestamp, audience array, expiry, unique nonce, revocation locator. Use @counter/trust-protocol buildUnsignedEnvelope and computeSha256Digest. Mandates reference attestation by digest rather than embedding it.
Task 4 - Consent text rendering: Implement plain-language consent text generation with version tracking. Consent text is immutable once generated for a given version.

Task 4 - Negative tests for Task 4: Test session downgrade rejection, stale step-up rejection, replay attack (same nonce), wrong digest/audience, self-bypass attempt, concurrent changes during consent, and assurance non-inflation (service-witnessed consent cannot satisfy WebAuthn/direct-principal requirements).
Run pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm depcruise to verify everything passes.
acceptance_criteria: Wallet lifecycle state machine validates all transitions and rejects invalid ones with errors
WalletAccount, WalletPrincipal, WalletInvitation types defined with proper branded IDs
In-memory repositories enforce wallet isolation (cross-wallet queries return empty)
Step-up service correctly identifies privileged operations and validates session freshness
Consent attestation creates valid CTP envelopes with all required fields
Negative tests prove: stale step-up rejected, replay blocked, wrong digest/audience rejected, assurance non-inflation enforced
All builds, tests, lint, and depcruise pass
